title: Give notice of documents and particulars filed for a UK economic interest grouping (UKEIG) (EE MP01)
text:
This form can be used to notify Companies House of documents and particulars required to be filed for a UKEIG.

 A fee of £30 is payable if the amendment of the grouping’s formation contract (if attached to this form) includes a change of name.

 Read our guidance for information on changes to company registration from 1 January 2021 .
